location.section: Rooted — Claude Code plugins rooted in evidence

patches.current: Skills for the full evidence-based preparation pipeline: research any topic with source verification, map its complete question space before you start, then write AI agent context that actually works — grounded instructions and disciplined reasoning instead of vibes. [Research shows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11988) LLM-generated context files do not generally improve agent task success while raising inference cost by 20–23% — and the repository overviews they typically contain are specifically unhelpful. Rooted admits rules by the scientific method instead: a claim rests on a test that could have refuted it, a norm is named as a norm and a decision as a decision. Software-development and code-review skills apply the same discipline to everyday coding.
patches.justification: temporal / contrast marker: 'instead of' — a candidate for review, not a finding

location.section: Rooted — Claude Code plugins rooted in evidence

patches.current: - **Lean context over static dumps.** For example, instead of an `/init`-style project-structure blob in `CLAUDE.md` (a file class shown not to improve success while raising inference cost 20–23%, with repository overviews specifically found unhelpful [[15]](#references)), orientation happens on demand via [`overview.sh`](overview.sh) with an explicit stop-instruction. The agent doesn't preemptively slurp the whole tree into context, so it doesn't fill its working memory with project content it doesn't need and later lose focus on the actual task.
patches.justification: temporal / contrast marker: 'instead of' — a candidate for review, not a finding
